fieldValues.title: Instance keys serialise in FieldAssignment.order
fieldValues.normative_statement: Instance `fieldValues` keys MUST be serialised in `FieldAssignment.order`, and nested composite objects likewise, so that a re-run of a transform is byte-idempotent and diffs are stable. This is the instance-side counterpart of the schema-key ordering in `projection-rules.md`; it supersedes the write-order signal of rfc-012:139. (RFC-039 [R18])
